headline: Clasico: Barcelona still favoured, handicap eases
summary: The market makes Barcelona clear favourites for the Clasico at 60.4% fair, with the draw at 16.9% and Real Madrid at 22.7%. Since our collector first saw the board, the Barcelona minus-one handicap fair slipped from 54.8% to 51.5% and the fair line eased from -1.19 to -1.07, with the result market moving in the same direction. That reads as a single market-wide re-rating of Real Madrid's chances rather than separate signals. Goals are priced high and flat: Over 4.0 at 50.6%, fair total 4.03, both teams to score at 72.3%. The injury feed is empty, which means no news data rather than no news. Confidence: medium.

voices.scout: Since we first saw this market, Barcelona's minus one handicap fair has slipped from about fifty-five per cent to fifty-one and a half, and the fair line has come in from minus one point one nine to minus one point oh seven. Home win's down from sixty-three to sixty point four, Real Madrid up from nineteen point eight to twenty-two point seven. Someone moved before the news.
voices.sceptic: Or nobody moved on news at all. The sharp book and a soft book repriced together at four twenty-six, then the rest followed — that's a market-wide adjustment, not one informed book. And the result and handicap are the same money on the same opinion, so it's one re-rating, not three signals. On a seven-book board, that fair-line drift is a nudge.
voices.gaffer: So the reading is one market-wide re-rating of Real Madrid's chances, medium confidence, and a goals line parked at four.
